# AgentAuth Protocol

> Open system design and protocol profile for AI agent identity, authentication, authorization, delegation, federation, runtime attestation, and native Login as Agent.

Canonical source: https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-auth-protocol
Original system design: Mamdouh Aboammar
Current design: AgentAuth v0.2 draft
Status: System Design

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-auth-protocol/blob/main/README.md): concise project overview and system-design map
- [Documentation landing](https://immamdouhaboammar.github.io/agent-auth-protocol/): search-oriented documentation entry point
- [Domain language](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-auth-protocol/blob/main/CONTEXT.md): canonical terms
- [Normative protocol core](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-auth-protocol/blob/main/docs/24-normative-protocol-core.md): protocol invariants and lifecycle
- [Conformance matrix](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-auth-protocol/blob/main/docs/31-conformance-matrix.md): profile requirements
